digest.component_or_area: ticket store maintenance — fsck and compact-all commands
propositions: Default fsck and compact-all scans visit only active (non-archived) tickets, skipping archived dirs via marker + net-archival confirmation, reducing O(all tickets) walk to O(active tickets) for routine health checks.

rebar archive performs a terminal fold inline before writing the ARCHIVED event, ensuring just-archived tickets have complete SNAPSHOTs covering all events with threshold=0 and horizon=0 gates bypassed.
fsck and compact-all accept --include-archived flag to restore full-walk behavior for deep audits and legacy tickets archived before the change that lacked inline folds.
Reverted-archive tickets (stale .archived marker without net-archived state) remain included in default scans via confirmation-step logic, not marker-only decision.
Store-wide metrics (authorship tallies, signed/unsigned totals) continue visiting all tickets regardless of --include-archived scope; the flag affects only which findings are reported.
